typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "DE PHYSIQUE" exhibits the classic characteristics of the Didone style: a high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed (hairline) serifs. This style was prevalent in academic and formal printing during the 19th century.
